visual_action: A slideshow of still photos featuring politician Abigail Spanberger. In the first photo, she is casting a ballot into a voting machine. Subsequent photos show her posing with supporters, one of whom holds a "PANBERGER SHMI JONES" sign, speaking at a podium to a crowd and media, and posing with another group of supporters holding signs that say "MEDICAID SAVES LIVES" and "MEDICAID CUTS = JOB CUTS".
